title: No Notifications!
body:
Hi! The app is very thought through, it’s incredibly helpful! BUTTTT it’s not notifying me anymore??

It notified me about my tasks at the set time just fine on the first day I downloaded, it’s not anymore. I also tried deleting and downloading again and nothing happened. And it’s not all that useful without notifications for me! 

A lottt of people have mentioned in google support that they faced the same issue, please look into it?
